p: Moriah: Signifying the fear of God, in which place he was also honoured, Solomon later building the temple there.
offer him there for a burnt: This was the main point of his temptation, seeing that he was commanded to offer up him in whom God had promised to bless all the nations of the world.
come again to you: He did not doubt that God would accomplish his promise, even if he should sacrifice his son.
burnt offering: The only way to overcome all temptation is to rest on God's providence.
bound Isaac his son: For it is likely that his father had told him God's commandment, to which he showed himself obedient.
know that thou fearest God: That is, by your true obedience you have declared your living faith.
be seen: The name is changed to show that God both sees and provides secretly for his and also evidently is seen, and felt in the right time.
myself have I sworn: Signifying, that there is none greater then he.
concubine: Concubine is often used to refer to those women who were inferior to the wives.
